mapper.sql: id, name, type, threshold, amount, discount, max_discount, total, issued, per_limit, start_time, end_time, status, gmt_created, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `coupon` (id, name, type, threshold, amount, discount, max_discount, total, issued, per_limit, start_time, end_time, status, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{type}, #{threshold}, #{amount}, #{discount}, #{maxDiscount}, #{total}, #{issued}, #{perLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `coupon` ORDER BY gmt_created DESC
SELECT FROM `coupon` WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND start_time <= NOW() AND end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY gmt_created DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE `coupon` SET issued = issued + 1, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND issued < total

UPDATE `coupon` SET name = #{name}, threshold = #{threshold}, amount = #{amount}, discount = #{discount}, max_discount = #{maxDiscount}, total = #{total}, per_limit = #{perLimit}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
